title: Figures 9-10: Colliding Beam Fusion Reactor and DPF Thruster System with Direct Conversion
description: Figure 9, 'Colliding Beam Fusion Reactor [Cheung et al. 2004]', is a cutaway schematic labeling a thermoelectric converter/shield, direct energy converter, ion injectors #1 and #2, magnetic separatrix, magnetic field coils, magnetic-field-reversed core, nozzle and plasma thrust. Figure 10, 'DPF Thruster System with Direct Conversion', is a line schematic showing a hydrogen tank feeding tanks marked P and B, a focus region and a magnetic nozzle.
